description: Resolve an ENS name to an address, or an address to its primary ENS name, via the Ethereum mainnet Universal Resolver (CCIP-read / offchain names supported). Pass exactly one of 'name' or 'address'. You only pay for successful reads: invalid input, not-found and upstream errors cancel settlement. ($0.002 USDC on Base)

address.description: Address to reverse-resolve to its primary ENS name.

name.description: ENS name to resolve, e.g. vitalik.eth.

name: chain_ens_resolve
